wiki.title: Charles H. Clements
wiki.extract: Charles H. Clements (born August 21, 1943) is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate, representing the 2nd district since January 28, 2017. Prior to this, Clements represented the 5th District in the West Virginia House of Delegates from 1995 to 1998.
